residents.work_line: Veysha Never-Signed: "I remember you. We spoke near the shelter without an address; I can tell you what I saw here, not what distant cities claim happened."
residents.agrees: Veysha Never-Signed: That route fits the work I protect. Your receiving date tells me a bundle arrived; it does not tell me what every witness saw.
residents.disagrees: Veysha Never-Signed: I would have kept a different lane. I can accept your dated receipt and still disagree about the road.
residents.home_line: Veysha Never-Signed: You came back to this threshold. I remember the day you brought the receiving account.
